$comment: Performance budgets in milliseconds. GALEO_PERF_ENFORCE=1 (the release check, on the owner's machine) holds the median to these; other runs fail only above 3x. Cold start: tightened on 2026-10-21 to the profiled build's medians + ~10 % (owner; 850 / 1300 ms since v0.1, PRD 2026-10-05); the PRD's 500 ms target stays the goal. warmSwitchMs is one frame at 60 Hz (the PRD's 'next frame'). splitTypingMs: last keystroke to the preview painted, in a 5,000-word article in split, the 150 ms typing pause included (owner, 2026-10-09, from a 260 ms median). jsonTreeOpenMs / csvTableOpenMs: launch to the first row painted, a 9 MB / 195k-node JSON and a 100 MB CSV, cold start included (csvTableOpenMs is ADR-020's target; jsonTreeOpenMs a starting value, both set from the first measurements).
